purpose: Ask a contact to put his name to a standing policy

options.text: on a matter of standing policy
with a proposal I think will suit us both
because I have very little else left to try
and will come straight to the point

steps.prompt: What the Crown will bear of it, each month

options.label: bear the whole charge — {param:cost} a month
options.text: Let it be settled, and let the whole of the charge fall on the Crown{insert:warmth}. I will not have it said that I asked a man to fund my own policy.

warmth.pleased: . You have enough to carry without this

options.label: bear half, and say so plainly
options.text: The Crown will meet half the charge. I will not pretend that is generous, only that it is what there is, and I would rather tell you the truth about it than dress it up.

options.label: bear none of it
options.text: There is nothing in the Treasury for this. I am asking you to carry it entire{insert:edge}, and I am aware of what I am asking.

tone.desperate: I shall not forget it if you do this.
